notes: IosAuthRepository now settles its Supabase logout attempt before clearing the Keychain-backed session and returning logout completion to the caller.
Local session retirement remains guaranteed after an HTTP failure or transport exception. Cancellation is propagated after the finally block retires the local session.
The exact-SHA Kotlin/Native iosX64 suite passed four tests on the macOS Intel host. The report records the test XML and complete Gradle log hashes without retaining absolute host paths.
The independent review found one P3 coverage gap for transport exceptions and cancellation. Both policies were made explicit and covered before the Product SHA was frozen.

This focal result proves ordering and local retirement semantics with the production repository and an injected transport. It does not prove that a particular backend session was revoked, bound latency on a nonresponsive network, unregister push tokens or recertify Android/Web.
No Android or Web runtime blob changed, so their matrices were not repeated solely for this SHA.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates affected evidence; attestation-only documentation remains subject to scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs.
